column1: # Observed U.S. data-center area series used for the updated chart.
# original_million_sqft: visually digitized from Fig. 14(a) of Winzer,
# Neilson, and Chraplyvy, Optics Express 26, 24190-24239 (2018). It is
# aggregate physical floor-plan area for Google, Facebook, AWS, and Microsoft.
# Values are approximate because the paper does not publish the underlying table.
# dckb_hyperscale_million_sqft: annual Q4 operating Net IT space for U.S.
# hyperscale records in the 451 Research Data Center KnowledgeBase, via the
# aggregate-only U.S. Data Center Atlas. These are observed database values,
# not forecasts, but Net IT space is not identical to gross building floor area.
